CreepJoinerFormKindDef.label: quiet drifter
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.description: A quiet wanderer who appeared at the edge of the map without explanation. {PAWN_pronoun} asks for shelter, gives no clear answer about {PAWN_possessive} origin, and watches the colony with the patience of someone who has nowhere else to be.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterLabel: A weathered stranger walks in from the edge of the map.
CreepJoinerFormKindDef.letterPrompt: The stranger arrives without ceremony - no caravan behind {PAWN_pronoun}, no obvious purpose ahead. {PAWN_possessive} clothes are scuffed and patched, {PAWN_possessive} gear well-used but cared for.\n\n{PAWN_pronoun} asks only for shelter, and to be allowed to stay a while. {PAWN_pronoun} will not say where {PAWN_pronoun} came from.
